scope: new or materially modified Enterprise Math research calculations, numerical experiments, exact arithmetic helpers, and readout code
purpose: Keep division and roots symbolic by default; require BRC-mediated evaluation whenever either is actually calculated; use arbitrary-precision integers for high-precision evaluation; keep float/decimal representations outside the native arithmetic state.
authority_note: This is an operational computation policy and tool interface. It does not prove a division-collapse theorem, root-collapse theorem, or new multiplicity-aware BRC theorem, and it does not grant Foundation status.

requirements: numerator is an explicitly represented non-negative integer state in the current natural-number facade
denominator is an explicitly represented positive integer state
construction of DIV does not itself evaluate the quotient
allowed_without_brc_evaluation: store or transmit the DIV node
form exact integer-coefficient addition or multiplication rewrites that retain an explicit denominator
cross-multiply for exact ordering/equality comparisons without materializing a quotient
attach provenance, scale, unit, or precision metadata

requirements: radicand is an explicitly represented non-negative integer state in the current natural-number facade
degree p is a positive integer
construction of ROOT does not itself evaluate a root index or decimal root
allowed_without_brc_evaluation: store or transmit the ROOT node
attach provenance, scale, unit, degree, or precision metadata
retain ROOT symbolically inside a larger expression when no root-derived value is materialized
root_state.signed_boundary: This V2 operational facade covers non-negative integer radicands. Existing signed-root semantics remain separately typed and are not silently folded into this rule.

division_must_enter_brc_when: a remainder or divisibility decision is requested
a same-state-space multiple collapse is requested
a finite-precision digit/readout value is requested
rounding, truncation, floor, or other quotient-derived materialization is requested
an algorithm otherwise needs to replace DIV by a calculated value
root_must_enter_brc_when: an integer root index is requested
perfect-power membership is requested through a root calculation
a perfect-power collapse state or residual is requested
a finite-precision root digit/readout value is requested
an algorithm otherwise needs to replace ROOT by a calculated value
forbidden_bypass: Decimal used as a native exact-arithmetic state
Fraction used to silently materialize/reduce native division
math.sqrt or equivalent floating root used as native evidence
math.isqrt or direct integer-root helper used outside the BRC facade on a governed path
direct quotient helpers in governed research code when the BRC evaluation facade is available
direct integer_nth_root/collapse/scaled_root helpers in governed research code when the BRC evaluation facade is available
fixed-width integer arithmetic without an explicit proven-safe bound

high_precision.rule: precision scale is a positive arbitrary-precision integer; scaling is performed exactly before BRC evaluation
preferred_carriers: other arbitrary-precision integer implementations with explicit exact semantics
high_precision.division_decimal_example: For k decimal places, scale = 10^k is an integer. Evaluate DIV(scale*n, d) through BRC. Decimal text is a readout of the resulting integer quotient; residual remainder remains explicit.
high_precision.root_decimal_example: For ROOT_p(n) at k decimal places, scale = 10^k and scaled_radicand = n*scale^p are integers. Evaluate ROOT_p(scaled_radicand) through BRC. The returned root index is the finite-scale readout integer and the residual collapse coordinate remains explicit.
high_precision.no_precision_ceiling: No project-level decimal-digit ceiling is imposed by the arithmetic model. Practical resource limits are implementation limits, not mathematical truncation authority.

legacy_boundary.existing_code: Existing historical code is not automatically reclassified as invalid. New and materially modified research calculation paths should migrate to this policy before their numerical output is treated as native exact evidence.
legacy_boundary.external_numerical_oracle: External floating-point or numerical libraries may be used only as explicitly typed oracle/readout/heuristic layers with declared precision/error semantics; they do not replace native exact evidence.

tool_reuse_resolution.how_applied_or_why_not: P007 supplies exact quotient/remainder and multiple-collapse primitives; the existing integer-root/perfect-power core supplies exact root/collapse primitives; T5 supplies integer precision/refinement and arbitrary integer scale semantics; BRC supplies the mandatory materialization boundary. The facade operationally composes them without claiming a new theorem family.
tool_reuse_resolution.hard_boundary_checked: Boolean-support BRC does not thereby gain a proved multiplicity theorem, and this operational policy does not prove division or root collapse as a new BRC theorem.
